rationale: The agent did look up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved order and product details, but it executed exchange actions without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. It also used a new_item_id (4068787148) that was not among the product details it fetched, so the selection was not supported by the tool outputs shown. There is no clear confirmation of charges/payment method or shipping/return instructions provided, and no final, correct summary of the changes. While it appears to have acted on the correct user, the lack of confirmation before writes and incomplete/unsupported information constitute a failure under the policy.
